newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns A1 to Mitsui's planned yen bond.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A1 to Mitsui's planned yen bond.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday that it had issued an A1 rating for Mitsui & Co's proposed issue of 10 billion yen callable bonds due 2003.
The rating reflects the trading house's diversified earnings stream and comparatively strong capital base, Moody's said.
Moody's said the rating also took into account an erosion of Mitsui's core trading franchise and changes in its risk profile arising from its diversification investment strategy.
